description: Use when a staging or preview deploy should match production, or a migrated site its old one: it compares the pages of both origins and answers only the pages that are missing, changed or look different. Free up to 100 pages per client address per day, no key needed.

checkMode.description: full (existence, content and visual, the default), text-only (no screenshots) or existence-only.

idempotencyKey.description: Retry key: under a prepaid balance, the same value within 24 hours is not charged again and answers DUPLICATE_REQUEST with the first jobId.

maxPages.description: Without paths: pages discovery compares, default 10.

maxPriceUsd.description: Spend cap in USD: a job priced above it is refused before any challenge.

paths.description: Pages to compare, each starting with /; skips discovery.

previewUrl.description: The preview or staging site (full URL), compared as Site B.

productionUrl.description: The production site (full URL), compared as Site A.

threshold.description: Visual diff tolerance as a fraction from 0 (exact) to 1: 0.05 means 5%. The web app takes a percentage; the API does not.

name: diff_deploy
title: Diff deploy
